replies.question: Can I return a mattress after opening it and sleeping on it?
replies.reply: Yes. After sleeping on it for at least 30 nights, you can request a free return if you’re still dissatisfied, provided it’s within 100 days of delivery and in sanitary, donatable condition—with no rips, stains, or excessive wear. Contact the Customer Care Team at support@novilla.us to start the return. The sleep trial applies to mattresses bought directly from novillashop.com; clearance items are final sale.

replies.question: If I return an opened mattress, is return shipping free or do I pay for it?
replies.reply: Return shipping is free for an opened mattress if you’ve slept on it for at least 30 nights and request the return within 100 days of delivery. It must be in sanitary, donatable condition, with no rips, stains, or excessive wear.

replies.question: Can I return a mattress that I bought on sale or at a discount?
replies.reply: It depends on whether the mattress was a clearance item. Clearance mattresses are final sale and can’t be returned for a change of mind or personal preference. For other mattresses bought directly from novillashop.com, the 100-night trial applies: unopened or unused mattresses that can be restored to their original packaging may be returned within 30 days of delivery; opened mattresses can be returned after at least 30 nights and within 100 days, if they’re in sanitary, donatable condition. The policy doesn’t specify whether other sale or discounted mattresses are excluded.

replies.question: Can I return a mattress after opening it and sleeping on it?

replies.question: If I return an opened mattress, is return shipping free or do I pay for it?
replies.reply: If the mattress has been fully expanded or inflated, it may still be accepted for return, but you’ll be responsible for the return shipping cost. It must be unrolled and still in its original compressed, deflated condition to qualify under the stated mattress return conditions; the policy doesn’t specify whether shipping is free in that case.

replies.reply: No. The store’s policy says sale items cannot be returned. For mattresses generally, returns must be requested within 30 days of delivery; expanded mattresses may still be accepted, but you would pay return shipping.
